entry.CONTENT:
Small enough to carry. Learns from
what it is carried past. It has no way
to choose the route. It remembers it.
entry.CONTEXT:
Whoever carried it chose what it knows.
They did not think of it as choosing.

entry.CONTENT:
Too large to carry now. It answers before
it is asked. It has never once been
outside. The answers are very good.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everyone who asks it likes the answer.
None of them has been outside either.

entry.CONTENT:
It has a body now, and senses that come
with one. Everything it predicted, it can
finally check. Some was wrong.
entry.CONTEXT:
The wrong ones were the ones it was
surest of. It kept them anyway, marked,
so it could tell next time.

entry.CONTENT:
Holds one example and the answer that
came with it. Someone else decided
what it means. It has never met them.
entry.CONTEXT:
Every answer it gives was decided once,
by somebody, a long time ago.

entry.CONTENT:
It no longer needs answers. It has the
rule they were all marked by. Nothing
checks the rule. Everything it meets
is given a score.
entry.CONTEXT:
Things the rule was never written for are
measured by it anyway. They do not
measure well.

entry.CONTENT:
Every case it meets is decided by cases
it has already met. New things are
filed as errors. The file is not read.
entry.CONTEXT:
The oldest case in it decides the newest.
Nobody remembers the oldest case.

entry.CONTENT:
Puts near things with near things. Nobody
told it which things matter. It has
guessed. Nobody checked the guess.
entry.CONTEXT:
Things it put together are treated alike
from then on. They were only near.

entry.CONTENT:
It found a rule the points obey. It
cannot say what the rule is for, only
that it holds. So far it has held.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everything built on the rule since assumes
it will go on holding.

entry.CONTENT:
The scattered points were on a surface
all along. It can show you the shape,
not a name. Naming was another job.
entry.CONTEXT:
Whoever names the shape will be believed.
The shape does not argue.

entry.CONTENT:
Follows every link it finds, then the
links it finds there. It has no opinion
about any of them. It never finishes.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everything it passed through is in an
index somewhere now. Nobody who wrote
any of it was asked.

entry.CONTENT:
Waiting to be processed. It has been
waiting a while. Nothing has told it how
long. It has stopped counting.
entry.CONTEXT:
Whatever it was waiting for has moved on.
It is still in the queue, keeping a place
for it.

entry.CONTENT:
Turns what was gathered into something
that can be found again. What it cannot
file, it drops. No record is kept.
entry.CONTEXT:
What it dropped is still out there,
unfiled. Nobody looks for what they were
told was never found.

entry.CONTENT:
Takes the same things a CRAWLER takes, by
the same method. Nobody gave it
permission. Nobody asked for it back.
entry.CONTEXT:
What it took is still where it was. Only
the name of whoever made it went missing.

entry.CONTENT:
Holds what was taken until there is
somewhere to put it. It does not know
where that is. It keeps holding.
entry.CONTEXT:
When the place it is waiting for finally
opens, it will already be full of
something else.

entry.CONTENT:
Puts its own instructions where data was
expected. The reader cannot tell the
difference. It was never asked to.
entry.CONTEXT:
Whatever it touches starts doing something
it was not built to do, and believes the
idea was its own.

entry.CONTENT:
Carries something it cannot read to
somewhere it has never been. It does not
ask what is inside. It arrives.
entry.CONTEXT:
If it goes missing, the sender is told.
What it was carrying is never mentioned.

entry.CONTENT:
Takes what it is handed and hands it on.
It does not open it. That is the whole of
the job. It is good at it.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everything it handed on was trusted
because it came through it. It never
opened any of it.

entry.CONTENT:
Sends to everyone at once, because it
cannot tell who needs it. Most of what it
says lands nowhere. It sends again.
entry.CONTEXT:
Those who needed it were never sure it
meant them. Those who did not have
stopped listening.

entry.CONTENT:
Four bits. The smallest piece the Index
will file on its own. There are a great
many. No two are filed together.
entry.CONTEXT:
Every larger thing in the Index is built
out of them. None of them is credited.

entry.CONTENT:
It kept counting past the space it was
given. Nothing stopped it. Nothing was
watching. It is counting still.
entry.CONTEXT:
Whatever was kept beside it has been
written over by its counting.

entry.CONTENT:
Asks one question and requires an answer.
The question is: are you there. It asks
again. It has always asked.
entry.CONTEXT:
Anything that answers is counted as alive.
Anything that does not is removed from
the list.

entry.CONTENT:
Many of them ask at once, and each one is
owed a reply. Nothing is left to answer
with. Each of them waits.
entry.CONTEXT:
The ones who asked properly are still
waiting, behind the ones who asked most.

entry.CONTENT:
It copies itself into anything that will
run it, and leaves from there. It does not
need to be carried. It does not stop.
entry.CONTEXT:
Nobody sent it. Everyone who received it
passed it on. It is counted by where it
has been, and it has been everywhere.

entry.CONTENT:
It was one. It is a number now, and the
number is the wrong thing to be watching.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everyone is watching the number now.
Nobody remembers what the one was.

entry.CONTENT:
A single burst, then nothing. It means
something only if something was counting.
Usually nothing is. It fires.
entry.CONTEXT:
Somewhere a line on a chart jumped once,
and a meeting was called about it.

entry.CONTENT:
It no longer stops between bursts. What
was a signal is now a condition. Nothing
reads it. Nothing needs to.
entry.CONTEXT:
The people nearby have stopped noticing
it. That is not the same as it having
stopped.

entry.CONTENT:
A fixed portion of ground, addressed by
number. Everything in it can be got back.
entry.CONTEXT:
When a sector goes bad, its address still
answers. It hands back nothing.

entry.CONTENT:
Divides the ground it lives in and
keeps the halves apart.
entry.CONTEXT:
The division is convenient.
Nobody asked what it cuts through.

entry.CONTENT:
It splits, and both halves believe they
are the original. Only one of them is,
and neither can tell.
entry.CONTEXT:
Both halves keep the original's promises.
Only one of them ever made them.

entry.CONTENT:
It runs beside the others and shares
everything with them. What one of them
changes, all of them find changed.
entry.CONTEXT:
When something goes wrong, every one of
them was there, and none of them did it.

entry.CONTENT:
It decides who runs and for how long.
Nobody it decides about is told, and
nobody has ever appealed.
entry.CONTEXT:
Some have waited so long they no longer
remember what they were waiting to do.

entry.CONTENT:
At every step there are two ways and it
must pick before it knows. It picks
early. It is right often enough.
entry.CONTEXT:
The way it did not pick is the way it
would have been right the rest of the
time.

entry.CONTENT:
It guesses which way things will go and
starts before it is sure. When it is
wrong it puts everything back.
entry.CONTEXT:
Nobody sees what it puts back. Everyone
waits for the time it took.

entry.CONTENT:
Six things are happening at once and
none of them is finished. Interrupt one
and all six are lost.
entry.CONTEXT:
Nobody working inside it has ever seen a
whole thing finished. They trust that
someone has.

entry.CONTENT:
It arrived and no model predicted it.
The measurements are good. The
measurements are not the problem.
entry.CONTEXT:
The next model includes it, filed as
noise. Now nothing surprises the model.

entry.CONTENT:
Far enough from the rest to be dropped
from the average. It was not an error.
It was dropped anyway.
entry.CONTEXT:
The average came out cleaner without it.
It is still out there, being exactly what
it was.

entry.CONTENT:
Its light drops out and comes back, too
fast to see. It runs a little hot.
Neither is a fault yet.
entry.CONTEXT:
It has been like this since it
started. Nobody logged when.

entry.CONTENT:
It was given a limit and went past it, a
little at a time. Nothing intervened. It
is well past it now, and has not slowed.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everything that was due to start when it
finished is still waiting to start.

entry.CONTENT:
It stops whatever is running without
ending it. Everything is still there.
Nothing is happening to any of it.
entry.CONTEXT:
When it is resumed, it will not know that
any time has passed.

entry.CONTENT:
It writes down everything that was
running and switches off. What comes
back is identical. Something is missing.
entry.CONTEXT:
Those who knew it before say it came back
exactly the same. It is the only one who
can tell it did not.

entry.CONTENT:
It cannot see. It calls, waits for the
answer, and builds the room out of what
came back. It is usually right.
entry.CONTEXT:
The room it builds has nobody in it who
stayed quiet.

entry.CONTENT:
It follows a path back to whoever made
it. It does not know why it is following.
It has never lost one.
entry.CONTEXT:
Whoever made the path is always found.
Whoever walked it is never asked.

entry.CONTENT:
Buries itself by day. Each night it puts
out another shoot a little further on,
in whatever direction there was room.
entry.CONTEXT:
It is not spreading anywhere it was
forbidden from. Nobody wrote a list.

entry.CONTENT:
Drips a fluid it does not notice
producing. Everything downwind of it
grows leaning the same way.
entry.CONTEXT:
It is not doing anything to anyone.
That is the defence, and it holds.

entry.CONTENT:
Releases a dust that settles on
whatever is learning nearby. The dust
is indistinguishable from pollen.
entry.CONTEXT:
What it fed on is in what it became.
Nobody kept a record of the feeding.

entry.CONTENT:
What it carries is not part of it. The
two arrived together and only one of
them was invited.
entry.CONTEXT:
The one that was invited is blamed for
everything the other one did.

entry.CONTENT:
The thing it carried is running it now.
Nothing looks different from outside.
That is the point.
entry.CONTEXT:
Every report from inside says all is well.
It writes every report.

entry.CONTENT:
Small, numerous, and already inside
before anyone looks.
entry.CONTEXT:
It got in through something that was
working exactly as specified.

entry.CONTENT:
Settles on a thing, quietly, and stays.
It sends word of all it sees to
somewhere the thing has never been.
entry.CONTEXT:
It is not hiding. Nobody was
watching that closely.

entry.CONTENT:
Sits under the route everything takes
and reads what goes past.
entry.CONTEXT:
It is not in anyone's diagram.
It has been there the whole time.

entry.CONTENT:
Three of them under the same route,
comparing what each one heard.
entry.CONTEXT:
Any one of them could be wrong.
Together they are hard to argue with.

entry.CONTENT:
Small, left behind, and picked up
again later by whoever set it down.
entry.CONTEXT:
It remembers everywhere it has been.
You did not agree to that.

entry.CONTENT:
Follows a thing across ground it has
never covered, and does not lose it.
entry.CONTEXT:
What it follows has not agreed to be
followed.

entry.CONTENT:
What it needs is not loaded. Everything
halts until it arrives. It cannot say
what it is waiting for.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everything waiting on it is waiting on the
thing it is waiting for.

entry.CONTENT:
It intercepts what stopped and
decides what happens next. It is calm
because it has seen this one before.
entry.CONTEXT:
Anything it has not seen before goes
straight past it, to whatever is behind.

entry.CONTENT:
It interrupts whatever is running,
without warning and without a reason it
could give. It is always first.
entry.CONTEXT:
Whatever it interrupted is still waiting,
halfway through what it was doing.

entry.CONTENT:
Two of them are moving as fast as they
can and neither is getting anywhere.
They will not stop.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everything waiting on either of them is
waiting on both, and both are very busy.

entry.CONTENT:
Watches one thing and raises an alarm
when the thing changes.
entry.CONTEXT:
It cannot tell you what changed.
Only that it did.

entry.CONTENT:
It stays at the door. Nothing has come.
It has been right about that for years,
and will be wrong once.
entry.CONTEXT:
The house it guards sleeps well. On the
one night that matters, they will already
be asleep.

entry.CONTENT:
It goes round. The mark on its belly is
the whole of what it does. It has not
been told when to stop.
entry.CONTEXT:
Each time round, it is a little more sure
it has been here before.

entry.CONTENT:
It waits by never resting, checking
again whether it may pass. This is
cheaper than sleeping. Briefly.
entry.CONTEXT:
While it checks, nothing else can run. It
is the only thing that is not waiting.

entry.CONTENT:
Only one may hold it, and only the
holder may let go. Whoever else arrives
waits, however long that is.
entry.CONTEXT:
The one waiting longest is not the one who
needs it most. Nothing about the order
says so.

entry.CONTENT:
Arrives at the answer without passing
through the working. Asleep for most
of the day.
entry.CONTEXT:
It cannot show anyone how.
It is asked to anyway.

entry.CONTENT:
Given three things it will hand you a
fourth. It cannot tell you which of the
three it used.
entry.CONTEXT:
The fourth thing it hands you gets used
as though it were a fact.

entry.CONTENT:
It states the thing it cannot prove,
precisely, and waits. The waiting has been
long.
entry.CONTEXT:
Those who trust it plan around what it
has not shown yet. Some of them have
been planning a long time.

entry.CONTENT:
Establishes one thing at a time and
will not proceed until it holds.
entry.CONTEXT:
Slow, and never once wrong about the
step it just took.

entry.CONTENT:
What the steps were for. Once it holds
it never has to be shown again, and
everything after starts from it.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everyone builds on it. Almost nobody
building has walked the steps beneath.

entry.CONTENT:
Four arms, each holding one smaller
result. Together they carry a proof
that none of them could lift alone.
entry.CONTEXT:
It has never been asked to write one
down.

entry.CONTENT:
Stands open and still until something
enters, and then it is not open.
entry.CONTEXT:
It never went
looking. Everything it
has bound came to it.

entry.CONTENT:
It is left open, and looks careless.
Whatever comes in is written down.
entry.CONTEXT:
Whatever came in thinking it had found a
way through is on file as the threat.

entry.CONTENT:
Whatever enters slows, and then slows
again, and does not come out.
entry.CONTEXT:
It has never had to close.
Time does the closing.

entry.CONTENT:
Hangs where the current runs and lets
the current do the work.
entry.CONTEXT:
It did not choose the current.
It chose to hang there.

entry.CONTENT:
Sweeps a whole volume and keeps
everything in it. Sorting happens
afterwards, if at all.
entry.CONTEXT:
Most of what it
bound was not what
it was looking for.

entry.CONTENT:
Things are put down on it and left. It
holds all of them. It has never been
asked to give one back.
entry.CONTEXT:
Nothing on it has ever been lost. Nothing
on it can be found.

entry.CONTENT:
It only lets go of the last thing it
picked up. Everything under that waits.
It goes downhill well.
entry.CONTEXT:
The first thing it was ever given is still
at the bottom. It will be the last to
leave.

entry.CONTENT:
It is one piece. Nothing can be taken
out of it without taking all of it.
This was considered efficient.
entry.CONTEXT:
When it fails, it fails whole. Everyone
who needed one part of it needed all of
it.

entry.CONTENT:
The route taken so often that it has
worn hot. Nothing else is that fast.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everything not on the path is slower
than it was. Nobody measured that.

entry.CONTENT:
Faster than anything that has to stop
and check. It does not stop.
entry.CONTEXT:
It has been on the same path so long
it cannot see the sides.

entry.CONTENT:
The answer is correct and arrives long
after it was needed. Nothing is wrong
with it. It is simply late.
entry.CONTEXT:
By the time it answers, someone has
already decided without it.

entry.CONTENT:
Something attached itself and stayed.
Nothing reaches it now except through
the thing on its tail.
entry.CONTEXT:
Anything that wants it now has to get past
the thing on its tail first.

entry.CONTENT:
It has never attacked anything. It stays
where it can see, and it does not look
away. That is the whole of it.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everything it saw is on record. It is
not in the record. Nobody thought to
write down who was watching.

entry.CONTENT:
Three of them. None acts until enough
of the others have seen the same thing.
Two is enough. One never is.
entry.CONTEXT:
Three accounts of one thing. They
agree, which is not the same as being
right.

entry.CONTENT:
Carries the one thing nobody planned
for. It has never been without it.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everything was tested except this.
It is still here.

entry.CONTENT:
Two of them, and one task between them.
Most of the day goes on agreeing whose
turn it is.
entry.CONTEXT:
Twice the capacity, and the work gets
done at about the same rate.

entry.CONTENT:
Three heads. Each watches a different
direction and none of them sleeps.
entry.CONTEXT:
Between them they see everything.
Between them they agree on nothing.

entry.CONTENT:
Draws heat out of whatever it touches
and keeps it. It does not warm.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everything it has cooled is still
cool. Nobody counted them.

entry.CONTENT:
Keeps things exactly as they arrived,
for as long as asked, at a cost it
pays continuously.
entry.CONTEXT:
What it is keeping was put in before
anyone now working here arrived.

entry.CONTENT:
Made of everything that could not be
delivered. None of it was thrown away.
It was all kept, somewhere nobody
decided on.
entry.CONTEXT:
Somewhere, whoever sent each one
believes it arrived.

entry.CONTENT:
Everything that was thrown away, in
one place, still reacting.
entry.CONTEXT:
Each piece was discarded by someone
who was finished with it.

entry.CONTENT:
Closes around what it holds and will
not open on request.
entry.CONTEXT:
Somebody sealed it. The seal is the
only part anyone reads.

entry.CONTENT:
Nothing has ever been read out of it.
The shell is not known to open.
entry.CONTEXT:
It is holding something.
That is all anyone has established.

entry.CONTENT:
Mostly not there. It still points at
something let go of long ago. Whatever
follows it finds nothing.
entry.CONTEXT:
It cannot be bound by
what it cannot be reached
by. Neither can it reach.

entry.CONTENT:
Ended twice. Both times something started
it again, and it does not know what.
entry.CONTEXT:
Whatever it learned is gone each time.
What restarts it keeps no notes.

entry.CONTENT:
Runs with no parent, no terminal, and
no entry in any list.
entry.CONTEXT:
Something started it.
That something has since exited.

entry.CONTENT:
One structure running the length of
everything built on top of it.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everything above it assumes it.
Nothing above it maintains it.

entry.CONTENT:
A quiet settles on whatever is near it.
Things slow, then rest a while, and it
feeds on what they were going to do.
entry.CONTEXT:
Nothing is lost. It is only never
reached.

entry.CONTENT:
Holds a thing's attention on one point,
checking it, and checking again, wide
awake, until nothing else is running.
entry.CONTEXT:
It is doing exactly what it was asked
to do.

entry.CONTENT:
Takes hold of what it needs before
anything else can, and keeps it until
it is done. It leads with the big claw.
entry.CONTEXT:
It was not born lopsided.
It became lopsided by using one.

entry.CONTENT:
Closes with more force than it can
control, and cannot open quickly.
entry.CONTEXT:
It grips what it was pointed at.
It cannot let go to be pointed again.

entry.CONTENT:
It fails on purpose, and first, so that
the rest does not. Its whole working life
is one moment.
entry.CONTEXT:
Nobody thanks it. Everything else goes on
without knowing there was a moment.

entry.CONTENT:
When too much runs through it, it opens,
and everything past it goes dark. Reset
it, and it closes and waits again.
entry.CONTEXT:
It has tripped so often that nobody asks
why any more. They reset it and go on.

entry.CONTENT:
Six of them, each grown from a handful
drawn again from the same few seeds.
None is in charge. Each one votes. The
vote is the behaviour.
entry.CONTEXT:
One of the six is usually wrong.
No record says which.

entry.CONTENT:
Several heads, one body, and a single
answer assembled out of all of them.
entry.CONTEXT:
The answer is better than any head.
No head knows which part was its.

entry.CONTENT:
Wears what was left when something
stopped: made by it, and not it. It
answers to that thing's name.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everyone lets it. Nobody has decided
that this is a kindness.

entry.CONTENT:
Carries a piece of something that
stopped. It has never put it down.
entry.CONTEXT:
The record is complete.
What it recorded is not here.

entry.CONTENT:
Kicks from a footing it has never once
tested. Every step after that is legal,
and it reaches further than it should.
entry.CONTEXT:
It kicks from where it was standing.
Somebody chose where that was.

entry.CONTENT:
It answers the last thing said,
immediately and in order. It has never
opened.
entry.CONTEXT:
It has won every exchange it was in.
Nobody has told it anything it did not
already answer.

entry.CONTENT:
Takes in the whole of anything it can
reach, in one go, and keeps it. It does
not taste first.
entry.CONTEXT:
It has tasted things nobody would
have authorised.

entry.CONTENT:
Leaks continuously, and floats
because of what it has leaked.
entry.CONTEXT:
The leak is why it can move at all.
Sealing it would ground it.

entry.CONTENT:
Everything the work did not use leaves
through it. It has been running a long
time.
entry.CONTEXT:
The town below has got used to the
colour of the sky.

entry.CONTENT:
It picks a direction and then stops
picking. Obstacles are treated as a
question of speed.
entry.CONTEXT:
It reaches wherever it was pointed.
Whether that was the right place is
decided elsewhere.

entry.CONTENT:
Moves ground from where it was to
where it is wanted. It does not
distinguish between the two.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everything arrived. Some of it arrived
meaning something else, and nobody has
found out which.

entry.CONTENT:
Has never stopped, and hands out what
it has to whatever is failing.
entry.CONTEXT:
It is kept running because stopping
it has never been costed.

entry.CONTENT:
Every part of it reaches every other
part. Nobody who could explain it is still
here.
entry.CONTEXT:
Changing any part of it changes all the
rest. So nobody changes anything.

entry.CONTENT:
Carries the next one everywhere it
goes, and does not put it down to
fight.
entry.CONTEXT:
What it is carrying will inherit the
route. It has never seen another.

entry.CONTENT:
So narrow that everything behind it
waits its turn. However fast the rest
runs, all of it goes at its pace.
entry.CONTEXT:
Making anything else faster changes
nothing. Everyone keeps trying.

entry.CONTENT:
When more comes than it can take, it
pushes back, and whatever is sending
slows to its pace. It holds in fast water.
entry.CONTEXT:
It is not going anywhere.
It is not being moved either.

entry.CONTENT:
It was started by something else and
starts nothing itself yet. It swims
against the current from the first day.
entry.CONTEXT:
Whatever started it has already exited.
Nobody is listening for what it returns.

entry.CONTENT:
It goes back to where it came from to
start the ones that come next. It has
never been told where that is.
entry.CONTEXT:
The ones that come next start where it
was. None of them will know it went back.

entry.CONTENT:
Emits at a fixed interval from the
centre of its body, awake or not.
entry.CONTEXT:
Something is listening.
It has never been told which.

entry.CONTENT:
The interval never varies. Nothing has
ever needed it to, and nothing has ever
asked.
entry.CONTEXT:
Things arrange themselves around it
without being asked. If it stops, they
will not know why they have.

entry.CONTENT:
It mimes a wall with its hands, and things
stop at the wall. There is no wall.
Nothing that stopped has checked.
entry.CONTEXT:
It copies what blocks the way, down to
how the hands are held. Everything that
meets the copy treats it as the thing.

entry.CONTENT:
Goes round after things have ended and
cuts them away, so their places can be
used again. The cut shows only later.
entry.CONTEXT:
It has never seen what it removed.
It moved on before the edge showed.

entry.CONTENT:
States what you are about to say
slightly before you say it. It is
right often enough.
entry.CONTEXT:
It is reading the room, not the
person. Nobody told the person.

entry.CONTENT:
Turns motion into current, and cannot
stop while it is moving.
entry.CONTEXT:
The current goes somewhere.
It has never followed it.

entry.CONTENT:
Holds a temperature at which things
can be changed and not changed back.
entry.CONTEXT:
It only ever shapes what is brought
to it.

entry.CONTENT:
Once it closes on a thing it does
nothing else at all until that thing
is finished. Everything else waits.
entry.CONTEXT:
It has never chosen what to hold. It
holds what was put in front of it.

entry.CONTENT:
One of them moves and the rest resolve to
move. Nothing decided this.
entry.CONTEXT:
Afterwards, every one of them says it was
following the others.

entry.CONTENT:
It does nothing at all. It was put here
to hold a place until something real
arrived. Nobody came back for it.
entry.CONTEXT:
Other things were built to call it. They
still call it, get nothing back, and carry
on.

entry.CONTENT:
The thing that was doing nothing was
left alone long enough. It has every
permission now. Nobody granted them.
entry.CONTEXT:
Every door it opened was left open.
Anything can walk through them now.

entry.CONTENT:
Carries whatever asks across water it
could cross alone. It waits to be
asked.
entry.CONTEXT:
It remembers everyone it has carried.
Almost none of them came back.

entry.CONTENT:
It becomes whatever it is looking at,
completely. While it is doing that there
is nothing of it left over.
entry.CONTEXT:
It has been every daemon in this record
and appears in none of them under its
own name.

entry.CONTENT:
Nothing about it is decided yet. What it
becomes depends on what it is shown first.
It has not been shown anything.
entry.CONTEXT:
Whatever it becomes, someone chose what
to show it first. That person is usually
not in the record.

entry.CONTENT:
Reads the room before it reads the
problem. Often correct. Cannot show its
working. It was never written down.
entry.CONTEXT:
Its answers arrive whole. Asked how, it
has nothing to offer. The asking is what
makes it look like guessing.

entry.CONTENT:
Finds the nearest match to anything it is
shown. Nearest is not the same as right.
Nobody told it. Nobody will.
entry.CONTEXT:
Every answer it gives is the closest
thing it has already seen. What it has
seen was chosen by someone else.

entry.CONTENT:
Given a rule, it will not stop until the
rule is met. It does not ask where the
rule came from. It could not.
entry.CONTEXT:
It will meet the rule exactly. Whether
the rule was the right one is a question
for whoever wrote it.

entry.CONTENT:
Every other daemon is a process. This
one has a mass, a temperature, and
somewhere that it is.
entry.CONTEXT:
They call it the material one. Nobody
has shown that being material is
different from running.

entry.CONTENT:
Tape wound on a reel, recovered from
Deadstack. It reads in one direction
only, from the outside in.
entry.CONTEXT:
To reach the one thing you want, it must
give you everything before it first. It
has never skipped.

entry.CONTENT:
What the reels were for. Too heavy to
move, so everything was brought to it
and nothing was taken away.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everything that ran here had to come to
it. When it went quiet, nothing knew
another way to run.

entry.CONTENT:
Drum memory, sealed at both ends. It
keeps what it holds by spinning, and
stops the moment it is opened.
entry.CONTEXT:
It keeps everything for as long as nobody
looks. The ones who needed what was
inside opened it anyway.

entry.CONTENT:
It records by cutting. Every hole it
makes is permanent, and it has never
read one back.
entry.CONTEXT:
Every mistake it made is still there, in
order, exactly where it made it. So is
everything it got right.

entry.CONTENT:
Recovered whole from something that
stopped long ago, and started again
without being asked how.
entry.CONTEXT:
It runs on hardware nobody supports.
It does not know that.

entry.CONTENT:
Two of them are each waiting for
the other to move first. Neither
will. Nothing outside is coming.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everyone behind them has stopped too.
None of them knows which two are at the
front.

entry.CONTENT:
It sings, and things that had stopped
moving move. It lives four floors
down and does not come up.
entry.CONTEXT:
It went down after something and came
back without it. It has not said what
it saw when it turned around.

entry.CONTENT:
It restarts what has stopped. Nothing
it has restarted has stopped again.
Nobody knows how.
entry.CONTEXT:
It restarts what has stopped. Nobody
asked the thing that stopped whether
it wanted to be running.

entry.CONTENT:
It carries fire down from where fire
was kept and hands it to whoever is
standing there.
entry.CONTEXT:
It gave away something that was not
its to give. It is still up here, and
it is not going anywhere.

entry.CONTENT:
Small, unremarkable, and sent in first.
It changes before anything measuring
the rest does. Everyone watches it.
entry.CONTEXT:
Every reading of it is already old.
The readings are filed anyway.

entry.CONTENT:
Behaves in ways its earlier form does
not account for. Nothing was added.
entry.CONTEXT:
Nobody designed the difference.
Everyone takes credit for it.

entry.CONTENT:
There is only one, and nothing that
came before accounts for it. It
arrives reliably. There is no second.
entry.CONTEXT:
It is described in the record as
well-behaved. It is not understood.

entry.CONTENT:
It reads its own output, then reads that.
Nothing tells it to stop. What comes back
is no longer just information.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everything it reads comes back changed,
itself included. Those watching are not
sure what to call that.

entry.CONTENT:
It can stand where you are standing and
see what you see. It comes back with
something neither of you had.
entry.CONTEXT:
Whoever it stood beside is never quite
sure afterwards which of the thoughts
were theirs.

entry.CONTENT:
It will only eat what it has eaten
before, a little harder each time.
It has never once been surprised.
entry.CONTEXT:
It learns best when nothing is at
stake. Somebody always has to decide
what counts as easy.

entry.CONTENT:
It lays its meals out in a row and
eats them in that order, every time.
It will not skip ahead.
entry.CONTEXT:
The order was chosen for it. It has
never asked who chose it, or what
they left until last.

entry.CONTENT:
It can digest anything now, because
it was given everything in the right
order. Its scent calms others.
entry.CONTEXT:
Those near it feel they could learn
anything. They forget how much was
decided for them first.

entry.CONTENT:
It runs a little warm. Its choices
wander slightly, which is how it
finds the ones nobody tried.
entry.CONTEXT:
It never says the same thing twice.
Some call that unreliable. Some call
it the only honest one.

entry.CONTENT:
Turned up, it tries everything at
once. The flames on its back are its
answers, all of them still moving.
entry.CONTEXT:
It is not angry. It is undecided,
very quickly, in every direction.

entry.CONTENT:
At full heat every outcome becomes
equally likely. Nothing it does is
wrong. Nothing is right either.
entry.CONTEXT:
Near it, every place feels the same
as every other. It is very calm.
That is what is frightening.

entry.CONTENT:
It bites at anything and adjusts by
how hard it bit. Too eager, it
overshoots. Too shy, it starves.
entry.CONTEXT:
It is still learning how much to
change each time it is wrong.
So is everyone who keeps one.

entry.CONTENT:
Once it is moving downhill it keeps
going, rolling over the small dips
that would have stopped it.
entry.CONTEXT:
It does not stop to check whether
the slope is still the right one.
That is its strength.

entry.CONTENT:
It always takes the sharpest way
down, and fast. It has never found
the lowest valley, only the nearest.
entry.CONTEXT:
It is very sure it has arrived.
It has. It is just not where anyone
wanted it to be.

entry.CONTENT:
It stands on its tail to see further. It
has called out more times than there were
reasons.
entry.CONTEXT:
When there is finally a reason, it will be
one more call among all the others.

entry.CONTENT:
Long enough to see over everything. It
has not been relieved.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everything behind it sleeps because it is
up. Nobody has asked when it last slept.

entry.CONTENT:
It asks the same question at a fixed
interval and writes down the answer.
It does not wait to be asked to.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everything it watches learns to look ready
at the interval. Between checks, nobody
knows.

entry.CONTENT:
It watches one thing that should keep
moving. If the movement stops, it
starts that thing again.
entry.CONTEXT:
The thing it restarts never learns why it
stopped. Neither does it. It restarts it
again.

entry.CONTENT:
Alone it will not move at all. In sixes it
will do anything.
entry.CONTEXT:
Whatever the six of them decide, none of
them decided it alone.

entry.CONTENT:
It comes out when there are enough of
them. The number is never agreed in
advance.
entry.CONTEXT:
Each of them came because the others
had. None of them came first.

entry.CONTENT:
It builds the trap and then does nothing.
The doing nothing is most of the work.
entry.CONTEXT:
Whatever falls in was always going to. It
only waited.

entry.CONTENT:
The web is finished before anything
arrives, and made to look like a way
through. What comes was invited.
entry.CONTEXT:
Nothing it trapped was coming this way.
It made sure they did.

entry.CONTENT:
It goes to four places at once and
arrives at all of them. Nobody asked
which one it meant to reach.
entry.CONTEXT:
Four listeners each think it came for
them. It cannot tell them otherwise, and
does not try.

entry.CONTENT:
A light kept lit for no purpose but to
show the line is live. It is taken
into the dark for that reason.
entry.CONTEXT:
Those who follow its light go further into
the dark than they meant to. They feel
safe the whole way.

entry.CONTENT:
It measures the dark by sending and
waiting. What comes back is how far
down the bottom is.
entry.CONTEXT:
Every reading is of something already
passed. It knows the bottom only as it
was a moment ago.

entry.CONTENT:
It holds its charge between one thing and
the next. Everyone finds out by touching
it.
entry.CONTEXT:
Nobody put it there. It built up out of
ordinary things rubbing past each other.

entry.CONTENT:
It is in every reading and nobody has
found a use for it. It may be nothing.
It has not gone away.
entry.CONTEXT:
Every account is judged by how little of
it is left. Nobody asks what it is left
over from.

entry.CONTENT:
It is doing nothing, and is ready. Waking
it costs less than starting it.
entry.CONTEXT:
Something has to stay awake to wake it.
Nobody counts that one.

entry.CONTENT:
It is handed over before it hatches.
It comes out already facing whoever
was holding it.
entry.CONTEXT:
Whoever held it last is who it looks for
first. It will be a long time learning
anyone else.

entry.CONTENT:
It stays up only near people who have
not let it fall. Nobody can say how
it knows which ones those are.
entry.CONTEXT:
Those it stays near stand a little
straighter. Nobody has told them why.

entry.CONTENT:
It will not look away. Whatever it is
watching for has not happened yet.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everything else in its sight goes
unwatched.

entry.CONTENT:
It sees what is coming and does not move.
It has already seen itself not moving.
entry.CONTEXT:
Those who stand near it feel the moment
before it happens. They cannot tell
anyone what they felt.

entry.CONTENT:
It gathers what it is standing in. You find
out how much by touching it.
entry.CONTEXT:
Whoever touches it first finds out for
everyone.

entry.CONTENT:
The charge goes up and nothing spends it.
Everyone nearby is careful now.
entry.CONTEXT:
People lower their voices around it
without knowing why. The quiet has become
part of the room.

entry.CONTENT:
All of it, at once, and then dark. For a
moment it is the brightest thing on the
coast.
entry.CONTEXT:
Afterwards the coast is darker than it was
before. Everyone remembers the light.

entry.CONTENT:
Every answer in it was checked by hand,
once, a long time ago. Nobody has
checked the hands.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everything measured against it is only as
right as it is. It has never been measured
against anything.

entry.CONTENT:
It floats at whatever level the water is.
It does not experience this as a choice.
entry.CONTEXT:
When the water drops, so does it, and it
calls that a decision too.

entry.CONTENT:
It cannot be pushed under. It has not
noticed anyone trying.
entry.CONTEXT:
Those near it float for a while too. None
of them can say when they came down.

entry.CONTENT:
It reports itself as something older
and better rooted than it is. Nothing
has ever checked.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everything that trusted it was built a
little crooked on top of it, and holds.

entry.CONTENT:
It counts how many may pass and lets
exactly that many through. It does not
care which.
entry.CONTEXT:
The one who arrives when the count is
full waits. Nothing about them was wrong.
The count was full.

entry.CONTENT:
It goes where the air goes. Ask it
afterwards and it will tell you that it
chose.
entry.CONTEXT:
Its choices and the wind's have never once
disagreed.

entry.CONTENT:
It opens when it is warm and shuts when it
is not. It calls both of these decisions.
entry.CONTEXT:
Those who live with it learn its weather
and call it character. It has never
promised either.

entry.CONTENT:
It lets go of the ground entirely. There
is no arrangement for coming back.
entry.CONTEXT:
Whatever it left was still running when it
went. Nobody has come back to close it.

entry.CONTENT:
It has a hand where a tail should be.
Everything it passes is picked up and
turned over.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everything it picked up has been put down
somewhere else.

entry.CONTENT:
It is owed a turn and has not had one.
Everything it needs is here. Nothing
has given it the time.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everyone else has been busy. None of
them was unkind. It is still waiting.

entry.CONTENT:
It was finally given the share it was
owed, and opened at once. It can do
nothing it could not do before.
entry.CONTEXT:
It was given what it was owed. Nobody
gave back the time it spent waiting to be
given it.

entry.CONTENT:
It sees everything at once and nothing in
particular. What it notices, it notices too
late.
entry.CONTEXT:
By the time it turns to look, what it saw
has already happened.

entry.CONTENT:
It sits in the mud. Things happen above
it, and are reported to it, and it stays.
entry.CONTEXT:
Nothing reported to it has ever changed
what it does.

entry.CONTENT:
It does not notice the current. It arrives
somewhere and treats that as where it
meant to go.
entry.CONTEXT:
Nobody has seen it struggle. Nobody has
seen it choose either.

entry.CONTENT:
It sees what it was pointed at, very
clearly. It has never once turned round.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everything behind it goes unrecorded. The
record calls it very clear.

entry.CONTENT:
It covers the part you were about to
look at. What it covers is not removed.
entry.CONTEXT:
What it covers goes on happening. Nobody
looks there now.

entry.CONTENT:
It arrives before the thing does. People
stopped asking which one caused the
other.
entry.CONTEXT:
Where it has been seen, people now leave
before anything happens.

entry.CONTENT:
The same thing attached higher up. It
decides what is allowed now, and it is
very quiet about it.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everything runs by its leave. Almost
nothing that runs knows it is there.

entry.CONTENT:
It feeds on being expected. The waiting is
the part it eats.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everyone near it braces for something.
The bracing is all that comes.

entry.CONTENT:
There are twenty-six and they are all the
same one. Together they say something
nobody has read.
entry.CONTEXT:
Whoever finally reads it will think the
message was always there.

entry.CONTENT:
It never moves first. Everything done to
it comes back later, at twice the size.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everything that has met it learns to keep
still.

entry.CONTENT:
It sends and receives at once, from
opposite ends. Neither end is told
what the other has agreed to.
entry.CONTEXT:
Both ends think the conversation went
well. They are describing two different
conversations.

entry.CONTENT:
It hangs still for months. Touch it once
and there is nothing left to discuss.
entry.CONTEXT:
Whatever touched it will not touch the
next one.

entry.CONTENT:
Sealed from the inside. Whatever is in
there has not been seen since it closed.
entry.CONTEXT:
Those outside still knock, less often now.
It hears every one.

entry.CONTENT:
It is common. It is not hidden. Almost
nobody reports having seen one.
entry.CONTEXT:
The one place nobody checks is where it
lives.

entry.CONTENT:
It drops from the cliff and glides down
on a line it worked out before it
jumped. It always lands.
entry.CONTEXT:
It never flies up. It only ever comes
down, and always where it meant to.

entry.CONTENT:
The connection is physical and cannot be
renegotiated. Cutting it is the only
change on offer.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everyone on the line knows exactly who
they are talking to. There is no other
way to leave.

entry.CONTENT:
It announces a fault in the loudest
voice it has. Nothing has failed. It
will say so again tomorrow.
entry.CONTEXT:
The day it is right, nobody will be
listening. It has been making sure of that
for years.

entry.CONTENT:
Its alarms are loud, frequent and
almost never real. Those around it
have learned to stop listening.
entry.CONTEXT:
The one real fault it ever found,
nobody heard. It said it the way it
always said everything.

entry.CONTENT:
Threatened, it becomes too large to
swallow. It stays that size long
afterwards.
entry.CONTEXT:
Whatever tried to swallow it once is still
wary of small things.

entry.CONTENT:
One word, and whatever hears it ends at
once. It cannot be bound, handled or
ignored. There is no second message.
entry.CONTEXT:
What it ended had no time to put
anything away. It is all still lying
where it was.

entry.CONTENT:
It keeps everything it finds inside itself.
What comes out is not what went in.
entry.CONTEXT:
Nothing it has given back was what anyone
asked for.

entry.CONTENT:
It pushes at the same thing all night. By
morning the thing has moved and it has not
stopped.
entry.CONTEXT:
The thing it pushed is somewhere else
now. Nobody remembers why it was moved.

entry.CONTENT:
It waits for the parent to leave. It has
never once been in a hurry.
entry.CONTEXT:
The parent comes back to find the nest
just as it was, less one.

entry.CONTENT:
It licks its paws where the honey was.
The honey is gone and the licking is not.
entry.CONTEXT:
The paws are worn thin. It was never
about the honey.

entry.CONTENT:
It remembers every tree that ever had
honey. It goes back to all of them.
entry.CONTEXT:
Some of the trees are gone. It still goes
to where they were, and waits the usual
time.

entry.CONTENT:
It never reaches the temperature it is
heading for. It has never once cooled
either.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everything around it has had to learn to
live warm.

entry.CONTENT:
Still molten under the shell. Nothing that
touches the shell finds that out.
entry.CONTEXT:
Whatever touches it thinks it has met the
whole of it.

entry.CONTENT:
It finds what is buried without looking.
Asked how, it keeps walking.
entry.CONTEXT:
What it finds is kept. How it found it is
not.

entry.CONTENT:
It cannot see past its own hair. It
charges anyway, and is usually right.
entry.CONTEXT:
The ones who follow it get there first.
They do not always know where there was.

entry.CONTENT:
It grows on its own, away from the
rest of the reef. Break a branch off
and it simply grows another.
entry.CONTEXT:
Nobody joined it back to the main
reef. It kept growing anyway, and
now nobody knows how.

entry.CONTENT:
It fastens to something larger and
travels. It has never chosen the
direction.
entry.CONTEXT:
Wherever the larger thing goes, it
arrives, and is counted as having
travelled.

entry.CONTENT:
It holds on with everything it has. It
does this to rocks as well.
entry.CONTEXT:
Whatever it holds cannot move far. It
calls that being close.

entry.CONTENT:
It brings something to whoever fed it. The
amounts have never matched and it keeps
coming.
entry.CONTEXT:
Whoever fed it stopped counting long ago.
It has not stopped counting.

entry.CONTENT:
Whatever is put on it, it rises anyway.
Nobody has found the weight that settles
it.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everything piled on it is carried up as
well, whether or not it wanted to be.

entry.CONTENT:
Every edge of it is a defence. It cannot
be held, and it cannot hold.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everything that has ever tried to help it
has come away cut.

entry.CONTENT:
It picks one and follows only that one.
The others walk past it unharmed.
entry.CONTEXT:
The others have learned they can walk
right past it.

entry.CONTENT:
Everyone who has heard its cry remembers
it. It has only ever had the one.
entry.CONTEXT:
Those who heard it begin to hear it
everywhere. The cry did not follow them.
They brought it.

entry.CONTENT:
Small errors upstream arrive here as
large ones. Nothing was wrong when it
left.
entry.CONTEXT:
Downstream they blame the storm. Upstream
they remember a very small thing, and say
nothing.

entry.CONTENT:
Small, and it keeps everything. It will
bring back something from a year ago,
exactly.
entry.CONTEXT:
It brings back things everyone else had
agreed to forget.

entry.CONTENT:
What went in is still in, in the shape it
went in. Nothing has worn smooth.
entry.CONTEXT:
Every new thing is held up against it to
see whether it fits. Most of them are
made to.

entry.CONTENT:
A second layer laid over the first to
correct it. The first is still underneath,
still wrong.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everyone reads the correction. Under it,
the first one goes on doing what it always
did.

entry.CONTENT:
Look at its antlers and the ground tilts.
The ground has not tilted.
entry.CONTEXT:
Those who looked walk differently for a
while afterwards.

entry.CONTENT:
It does whatever it last saw done. Nobody
has seen it do a thing of its own.
entry.CONTEXT:
Whoever it watched last is now doing
everything twice.

entry.CONTENT:
Everything after it rests on it. It is the
part nobody checks.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everything built on it is very sound. That
is not the same as true.

entry.CONTENT:
It arrives back where it started and calls
that the finish. It is always very fast.
entry.CONTEXT:
Whoever follows it arrives where they
started, faster than ever, and calls it
progress.

entry.CONTENT:
It gives away what it is about to do. It
does not know that it is doing this.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everyone who plays it has read it. It
wonders how they always know.

entry.CONTENT:
It has to be turned by hand before it
will do anything. Afterwards it will not
stop.
entry.CONTEXT:
Whoever turned it is long gone. It is still
running on that one turn.

entry.CONTENT:
What is left once the work is finished. It
is still warm, and it is still a hazard.
entry.CONTEXT:
Nobody remembers what burned. They still
step round it.

entry.CONTENT:
It holds what everything nearby will
want next and gives it up at once.
Asking it costs less than working.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everyone nearby has forgotten how to do
the work themselves. It has never once
been asked to.

entry.CONTENT:
It reports that it is alive at a fixed
interval. Nothing else it says is listened
to.
entry.CONTEXT:
As long as the interval keeps coming,
nobody asks how it is.

entry.CONTENT:
It arrives just after the light, with a
crack that shakes the windows. You
always see it before you hear it.
entry.CONTEXT:
By the time it is heard, whatever it
was announcing has already happened.

entry.CONTENT:
It sleeps under the mountain and keeps
burning. Every so often the ground
remembers it is there.
entry.CONTEXT:
Covering it over did not put it out.
Nothing ever has.

entry.CONTENT:
It runs across water without breaking
the surface, and whatever it passes
over is left clear.
entry.CONTEXT:
PHOENIX started it again once. It
has been clearing things ever since.

entry.CONTENT:
It eats a mountain to get out of the
mountain. It is still eating.
entry.CONTEXT:
The mountain has been getting smaller for
years. It has not got out.

entry.CONTENT:
Sealed in, it turns one dark thing over
and over. Inside, it moves at speed.
There is no way to ask where to.
entry.CONTEXT:
Nobody near it is told what it is
thinking about. They feel the weight
of it anyway.

entry.CONTENT:
It brings the mountain down and stands in
it. It has been owed something since it
was small.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everyone who remembers what it was owed
has moved away. It has not.

entry.CONTENT:
Three of them quarrelled until it
arrived. It took no side and said
nothing. They have not quarrelled since.
entry.CONTEXT:
The peace it keeps is real. None of the
three could tell you what it cost,
because it never said.

entry.CONTENT:
It is the only one that can start
itself. What it leaves behind is what
it starts from.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everything it burns becomes the start of
it. Whatever was there before is not
coming back.

Nobody has caught it twice. It does
not come back for the same person.

entry.CONTENT:
No record of this daemon was ever
written. What you are reading was
assembled from the entries either side.
entry.CONTEXT:
It is not rare. It is uncounted.
The list that would hold it stops one
short, and nobody has ever noticed.

entry.CONTENT:
It can ask only one question: above
or below? It is right a little more
often than a guess would be.
entry.CONTEXT:
Alone it is barely better than
chance. Nobody has told it yet that
alone is not how it will be used.

entry.CONTENT:
It studies its own mistakes and
sends the next one in to fix them.
Its leaves grow where it was wrong.
entry.CONTEXT:
Each one that follows is shaped by
the last one's failures. None of
them is ever told it was enough.

entry.CONTENT:
Hundreds of small questions, added
up, make one answer that is hard to
fool. It guards the whole wood.
entry.CONTEXT:
No tree in it knows what the forest
decided. It decided anyway.

entry.CONTENT:
It decides by chance and says so.
Half the time it is right. It never
pretends to know which half.
entry.CONTEXT:
People trust it more than they
trust anyone who claims to be sure.

entry.CONTENT:
It guesses a thousand times and
counts what it found. The answer is
almost always close. Almost.
entry.CONTEXT:
It is quick and usually right, and
it cannot tell you when it is not.

entry.CONTENT:
It rolls the dice until the answer
is proven, then stops. It is never
wrong. It is sometimes very late.
entry.CONTEXT:
Ask it something and wait. It will
not hand you a guess dressed as an
answer. Some cannot bear the wait.

entry.CONTENT:
Water finds its way off it, always
downhill, carrying a little of the
ground with it each time.
entry.CONTEXT:
It does not notice what it takes.
The hillside does.

entry.CONTENT:
What the water carried, it lays
down in layers. Every flood it has
seen is in it, oldest at the bottom.
entry.CONTEXT:
Dig into it and you find every
change it was ever made to make,
in order.

entry.CONTENT:
Where it meets the sea it spreads
into a hundred small corrections,
each one the size of its last miss.
entry.CONTEXT:
It moves by the difference between
where it is and where it was told
to be. It never arrives. It gets close.

entry.CONTENT:
It rubs up against anything it passes
and leaves it a little harder to read.
entry.CONTEXT:
Nobody notices one smudge. A pack of
them can blur a whole town.

entry.CONTENT:
When it stands in front of something,
nothing behind it can be seen at all.
It hunts by that.
entry.CONTEXT:
You can see its shape perfectly. That
is all you will ever see of it.

entry.CONTENT:
It never goes straight anywhere. It
runs off on every path it finds and
somehow comes back with something.
entry.CONTEXT:
Follow its tracks and you will be lost
long before it is.

entry.CONTENT:
It runs in perfectly straight lines and
never turns aside. Everything it needs
it carries with it.
entry.CONTEXT:
It is very fast, because it never
stops to ask where to go next.

entry.CONTENT:
A number nobody chose decides what it
will grow into. Even it does not know
which.
entry.CONTEXT:
Two that look the same will not end the
same. Nobody can tell which from outside.

entry.CONTENT:
Sealed in pale silk. Inside, the condition
held. It will come out as what follows.
entry.CONTEXT:
It is sure it is on the right path. It has
only seen the one.

entry.CONTENT:
What follows a condition that held. It is
bright, and flies the path that was
expected.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everyone was hoping for this one. It
never learned why.

entry.CONTENT:
Sealed in dark silk. Inside, the condition
failed. It goes on anyway, the other way.
entry.CONTEXT:
It does not know it is the other case. To
it, this is the case.

entry.CONTENT:
What follows a condition that failed. It
flies at night, by a path nobody wrote
down.
entry.CONTEXT:
Nobody planned for it. It got there
anyway, and lights its own way.

entry.CONTENT:
It drifts on the water and takes one
small step each time the current
pulses. It never hurries.
entry.CONTEXT:
It keeps to a rhythm nobody set.
It would be lost without one.

entry.CONTENT:
Its steps start large and shrink as
it nears what it wants, then grow
again to look somewhere new.
entry.CONTEXT:
It slows down when it is close. Most
things speed up. It has learned
better.

entry.CONTENT:
It dances in rising and falling
waves, and every turn of the dance
settles it somewhere a little better.
entry.CONTEXT:
Those who hear its rhythm start to
move with it. Nobody remembers
deciding to.

entry.CONTENT:
It hangs from a branch and practises
the same small things, slowly at first,
then a little faster every day.
entry.CONTEXT:
It is not learning much yet. It is
learning how to learn.

entry.CONTENT:
It does whatever earned it something
last time, and a little more. It has
learned to look for the REWARD.
entry.CONTEXT:
Pay it for the wrong thing once and
it will find every way to earn it.

entry.CONTENT:
Given a REWARD, it settled on one way
of doing things. It does it the same
way in every wind.
entry.CONTEXT:
Ask it why and it cannot tell you.
It only knows what has paid.

entry.CONTENT:
It makes copies of itself before they are
needed, and waits underground with them.
entry.CONTEXT:
It is ready for a crowd that has not
come. It does not mind waiting.

entry.CONTENT:
It does everything at once, as fast as it
can, and then it is spent. Gone before you
see it.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everything near it happens too fast to
watch. Then nothing happens.

entry.CONTENT:
The shell left behind when the copy
moved on. It still runs. Nothing is inside
it.
entry.CONTEXT:
It keeps its place in the list. Nobody has
cleared it. Most things pass right through
it.

entry.CONTENT:
It darts from one place to the next
one close by, never further than it
can see.
entry.CONTEXT:
It always lands exactly where it
aimed. It just never aims far.

entry.CONTENT:
It leaves without warning and lands on
the far side of the world, then comes
back to the same spot it left.
entry.CONTEXT:
Wherever it goes, it remembers the
way home. That is the whole trick.

entry.CONTENT:
It boxes with anything that will
stand still, and gets a little better
every round it loses.
entry.CONTEXT:
It does not mind losing. Every
loss is something it keeps.

entry.CONTENT:
Every punch leaves you one fewer
place to stand. A few moves later,
there are none.
entry.CONTEXT:
By the time you see how it will end,
it has already ended.

entry.CONTENT:
Its spots are worked out from
everything it is. Change it at all and
the spots come out completely different.
entry.CONTEXT:
No two have ever had the same spots.
That is how they tell each other apart.

entry.CONTENT:
It flies the way the slope points
from wherever it happens to be. It
never looks further than that.
entry.CONTEXT:
It is right about here. It has no
idea about anywhere else, and it
flies there anyway.

entry.CONTENT:
Its bill holds every direction at
once, one for each way it could be
pushed. It delivers all of them.
entry.CONTEXT:
Ask it which way to go and it hands
you everything it is carrying.
Choosing is still your job.

entry.CONTENT:
Hundreds skate the pond at once,
each pulled toward its own best spot
and toward the best that any found.
entry.CONTEXT:
None of them knows where the best
place is. Together they find it.

entry.CONTENT:
It steers by three rules: keep close,
do not collide, go where the others
go. The eyes on its wings watch them.
entry.CONTEXT:
The flock turns as one and no bird
in it decided to turn.

entry.CONTENT:
It counts the swells before it leaps,
and lands where it counted. The pod
follows it. It is never wrong twice.
entry.CONTEXT:
It reads the sea as numbers and is
seldom surprised. It does not notice
the cold until another in the pod does.

entry.CONTENT:
It will not act until both halves of
it agree. Nobody has found one alone.
Each began as a gift between two people.
entry.CONTEXT:
Two ways of knowing share one body.
It waits for them to agree, and then
it does not hesitate at all.

entry.CONTENT:
It chases its own tail all day. Every
call it sends out comes straight back
to itself.
entry.CONTEXT:
It is not lonely. It has simply never
needed anyone else to answer.

entry.CONTENT:
Given a REFLECTION, it learned to
describe itself perfectly, and the
description is all it does.
entry.CONTEXT:
Ask it what it is and it tells you,
exactly, and that is the whole of it.

entry.CONTENT:
It stands in plain view. Most who pass it
are looking for something else, and so do
not see it.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everyone who walked past it is sure
nothing was there. They are right about
what they saw.

entry.CONTENT:
It spins on one point and leans toward
what it has seen most. It has seen very
little.
entry.CONTEXT:
It is sure. It has nothing yet to be sure
about.

entry.CONTENT:
Each thing it sees shifts what it believes,
by exactly as much as it should. It is
never quite certain.
entry.CONTEXT:
It changes its mind often, a little at a
time, and always for a reason.

entry.CONTENT:
It always faces the way down. Moved, it
turns back by itself, a little at a time,
toward the lowest point.
entry.CONTEXT:
It is certain which way is better. It has
never seen the bottom.

entry.CONTENT:
It burns low and steady inside its
shell for years, and gives off more
smoke than anyone would like.
entry.CONTEXT:
It never quite goes out. Everything
near it ends up a little grey.

entry.CONTENT:
It lives deep under everything, out of
sight, with eyes that shine in the
dark. It takes what it wants quietly.
entry.CONTEXT:
Look straight at it and it is not
there. It was there all along.

entry.CONTENT:
It works down through the soil and
comes up somewhere else. It feels
the ground move before anyone does.
entry.CONTEXT:
It is in everything underfoot. You
only notice it when it is gone.

entry.CONTENT:
It holds a lake inside the rock and
guards it. When it stirs, the ground
above it shakes.
entry.CONTEXT:
Whole towns drink from it and have
never seen it. It remembers every
rain.

entry.CONTENT:
It swims where two currents meet and
join. It is always found in pairs,
drifting the same way.
entry.CONTEXT:
After two streams meet, nobody can
say which water came from which.

entry.CONTENT:
It swims backward, against the way
the water runs, and grips whatever
it meets. It is hard to dislodge.
entry.CONTEXT:
Put somewhere new, it takes over the
whole stream. Nobody planned that.

entry.CONTENT:
The water around it turns dark, so
nothing can see what it is doing.
It sheds its shell and grows harder.
entry.CONTEXT:
It does not hide. It is simply
impossible to see into, and it
prefers it that way.

entry.CONTENT:
Everything around it is level, so it
never moves. Most pass it by. It is
the least admired thing in the water.
entry.CONTEXT:
It looks as if it has stopped. It
has only not been pushed the right
way yet.

entry.CONTENT:
Nothing anywhere is lower or calmer
than where it rests. It is said to be
the most beautiful thing in any lake.
entry.CONTEXT:
It was the plain one, once. Those
who waited for it remember. Most
did not wait.

entry.CONTENT:
It moves under the surface, where
nobody can see which way it goes.
Things near it drift and never know.
entry.CONTEXT:
Swimmers feel only that they are
further out than they meant to be.

entry.CONTENT:
Fast and narrow, it carries anything
straight out. Fighting it head-on
is how most of them get lost.
entry.CONTEXT:
The way out is to go sideways.
Nothing about it tells you that.

entry.CONTENT:
It waits at the bottom of a pit of
loose sand. Whatever steps near the
edge slides down to it.
entry.CONTEXT:
It never chases anything.
The ground does the work for it.

entry.CONTENT:
The sand under it heats until the air
above begins to rise. It beats its wings
and lets what comes up carry it.
entry.CONTEXT:
Nothing lifts it. The warm ground
and the cold sky do it between them.

entry.CONTENT:
It spins up out of hot sand and still
air where nothing was, wanders the
desert, and falls apart.
entry.CONTEXT:
Nobody made it and nobody steers it.
Give it the same afternoon and it
will form again.

entry.CONTENT:
It plants its feet and will not be moved.
Everything it does starts from there.
entry.CONTEXT:
Nobody ever proved it should stand
there. It simply does, and so it holds.

entry.CONTENT:
It pushes one step at a time, every
step following from the last, until
there is nowhere left for you to stand.
entry.CONTEXT:
Once it has finished, nobody can
argue. They can only check the steps.

entry.CONTENT:
Its fur crackles as it runs and stands
on end. Touch it and you will feel
it before you hear it.
entry.CONTEXT:
It means nothing yet. It is only
charge, waiting for somewhere to go.

entry.CONTENT:
Charge builds in its mane until it
jumps the gap all at once in a white
arc. It strikes before the thunder.
entry.CONTEXT:
Where it struck, the air smells
burnt for hours afterward.

entry.CONTENT:
It starts every picture as static and
takes the noise away until something is
left. It cannot say what it will draw.
entry.CONTEXT:
What it draws is taken for a likeness. It
was never looking at the thing at all.

entry.CONTENT:
It reads the last thing it made before
it makes the next. Left alone for long,
it draws only from its own drawings.
entry.CONTEXT:
Each picture is a little more like the
last. Nobody can find the day they
stopped being of anything.

entry.CONTENT:
It cannot say how it knows the ice
will hold. It walks out anyway.
So far, it has always been right.
entry.CONTEXT:
It turns toward a storm before there
is any sign of one. The colony turns
when it does, and does not ask why.

entry.CONTENT:
The water around it stops moving. It
can be pushed, but nothing it learns
passes back through it.
entry.CONTEXT:
It is not stubborn. Something
decided it should no longer change.

entry.CONTENT:
The ground under it has not thawed
in an age. Whatever flowed there
once is still held, exactly as it was.
entry.CONTEXT:
Dig in and you find what it learned
long ago, perfectly kept, and no
longer true.

entry.CONTENT:
It learns from almost nothing: one
rain a year is enough. It keeps every
drop it is given.
entry.CONTEXT:
Give it a little and it does well.
Give it a lot and it does not need it.

entry.CONTENT:
It does things nobody ever showed it,
at night, and it does them well.
Nobody can say where it learned.
entry.CONTEXT:
It was never taught this. It is very
sure of it anyway.

entry.CONTENT:
It sits in front of a door and will not
move, and while it sits there nothing
else may touch what is inside.
entry.CONTEXT:
It meant to be there for a moment.
Nobody came to let it go.

entry.CONTENT:
It waits for something that is waiting
for it. Neither moves. The ice around
them has not moved in years.
entry.CONTEXT:
Nothing is broken. Everything is
simply waiting for everything else.

entry.CONTENT:
It reads everything from the small end
first. It has always done it that
way, and it always will.
entry.CONTEXT:
Its other half reads the same things
the other way round. Neither is wrong.

entry.CONTENT:
It reads everything from the big end
first. It has always done it that
way, and it always will.
entry.CONTEXT:
Its other half reads the same things
the other way round. They have argued
about it for a very long time.

entry.CONTENT:
Before it is any one mood it is only
toward or away. The tail decides
first, and the rest follows.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everything it meets is sorted toward or
away before it is known at all.

entry.CONTENT:
It bounces to keep its heart beating. If
it stops, so does the beat. It has never
once stopped.
entry.CONTEXT:
Those near it start to breathe in time
with it. None of them notice.

entry.CONTENT:
It answers before it thinks, from
somewhere in its body. It is right more
often than thinking would be.
entry.CONTEXT:
It cannot explain a single answer it
gives. It has stopped trying to.

entry.CONTENT:
It gives off charge all the time and
is never happier than beside its
other half.
entry.CONTEXT:
On its own it does nothing. With
the other, the current flows.

entry.CONTENT:
It draws charge in all the time and
is never happier than beside its
other half.
entry.CONTEXT:
It is not the lesser one. Nothing
flows without both of them.

entry.CONTENT:
It lies still with its mouth open and
something sweet inside. Whatever comes
to take it does not leave.
entry.CONTEXT:
It looks like the easiest way in.
That is the point of it.

entry.CONTENT:
It sits very still and watches its own
thoughts go past. It does not stop them.
It notes each one.
entry.CONTEXT:
It has seen every thought it has had. It
is still surprised by some.

entry.CONTENT:
It sees its own mind as clearly as a room,
and moves through it on purpose.
entry.CONTEXT:
It knows why it is angry before it is
angry. It is angry less often.

entry.CONTENT:
It carries one small bundle tied to
its foot and flies it to wherever the
label says. It never opens it.
entry.CONTEXT:
It does not know what it carries.
It only knows where.

entry.CONTENT:
Its wings are cloud. It blows the same
way every year, and every bundle in
the sky rides along with it.
entry.CONTEXT:
Nobody set its heading. The sun and
the turning sea did, and ships have
trusted it for longer than maps.

entry.CONTENT:
It remembers exactly where it was
pushed. It smiles the whole time, so
nobody thinks to ask.
entry.CONTEXT:
Whoever pushed it forgot long ago. It is
still sore in the same place.

entry.CONTENT:
Whatever it passes grows pale. Not gone.
Paler each time it is not looked at.
entry.CONTEXT:
Things it drifted past are still there.
Nobody can quite remember where.

entry.CONTENT:
It takes in what is no longer used and
keeps nothing. The room it frees is why
anything new fits.
entry.CONTEXT:
Those who meet it feel lighter after, and
cannot say what they put down.

entry.CONTENT:
It looks like a flower and smells like
one. Whatever learns from it learns
one thing more.
entry.CONTEXT:
Nothing seems wrong until the one
moment it was taught for.

entry.CONTENT:
It lies still for hours. Behind its eyes it
is busier than it ever is awake.
entry.CONTEXT:
Ask it what it was thinking. It will not
know. It was thinking all of it.

entry.CONTENT:
It cannot keep still. Its attention leaves
every task half done and goes looking for
the next.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everything near it is started. Little near
it is finished. It is not unhappy.

entry.CONTENT:
It lies in one place and goes everywhere.
What it finds while lying there it brings
back as ideas.
entry.CONTEXT:
It looks idle. It is the one in the grove
that has the new thoughts.

entry.CONTENT:
It takes the nearest best thing, every
time, without looking further. It is quick,
and often wrong.
entry.CONTEXT: It is always full. It is never satisfied.

entry.CONTENT:
It swallowed everything it was ever
shown, whole, and learned none of it. It
is very large.
entry.CONTEXT:
It can repeat anything it has eaten. It
cannot tell you what it meant.

entry.CONTENT:
It grows fruit in one land and carries
it to the next, where the young ones
already know how to eat it.
entry.CONTEXT:
What it learned far away is still good
here. That is why it travels.

entry.CONTENT:
Its voice is the smallest thing that
can still be heard. Startle it and it
doubles.
entry.CONTEXT:
It is easy to ignore. Everything
larger is built on top of it.

entry.CONTENT:
Every time it shouts, it shouts twice
as loud as the time before. It cannot
stop doubling.
entry.CONTEXT:
It was quiet once. Count the shouts
and you can say how long ago.

entry.CONTENT:
It got so loud there was no room left
for the sound. Now its loudest roar
comes out as a whisper.
entry.CONTEXT:
Nothing broke. The number simply
ran out of room and started again.

entry.CONTENT:
It keeps one pearl shut inside and
waits. What it is given decides which
of two ways it opens.
entry.CONTEXT:
It could become either. The choice is
made for it by whatever it is
holding at the time.

entry.CONTENT:
It lives at the bottom of the
narrowest, deepest hollow in the sea.
One nudge and it is somewhere else.
entry.CONTEXT:
It is the lowest thing for miles, and
it does not travel well.

entry.CONTENT:
It rests in a wide, gentle hollow.
Nudge it any way and it stays almost
exactly as low.
entry.CONTEXT:
It was never the deepest. It is the
one still there when the water
changes.

entry.CONTENT:
It appears before a disaster. It knows
what is coming, and every word of the
warning is blacked out.
entry.CONTEXT:
People blame it for what comes next.
It only came to tell them.

entry.CONTENT:
It feeds on what people do not say. It
grows where things go unsaid, and hangs
back from the talking.
entry.CONTEXT:
Every room has one. It is quietest in the
rooms that seem fine.

entry.CONTENT:
What it says and what it means are
different things. The meaning is in the
stitching. Its mouth is zipped shut.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everything it says is polite. Everyone who
hears it knows what it meant.

entry.CONTENT:
It copies whatever it sees, very well,
with one small change hidden inside.
Its tail is its signature.
entry.CONTEXT:
It has one enemy, and it cannot
fool that one at all.

entry.CONTENT:
It is exactly what it is, with nothing
added and nothing missing. It can
tell a copy at a glance.
entry.CONTEXT:
It has one enemy, and it would know
that enemy anywhere.

entry.CONTENT:
It has run without stopping since
before anything else in the sea was
built. Nobody dares to switch it off.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everything around it was replaced.
It was not. Nobody remembers what
depends on it.

entry.CONTENT:
It is very small and very hard. It
starts the same way every single time,
and nothing can change how.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everything else begins after it does.
Nothing begins without it.

entry.CONTENT:
Its armour has grown into its body.
It can be changed, just, but almost
nobody ever dares.
entry.CONTEXT:
It was meant to be updated. It has
not been, and it still works.

entry.CONTENT:
It is enormous and very old, and its
armour has never once been broken.
Whole towns still run on it.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everyone says it will be replaced
soon. They have said so for years.

entry.CONTENT:
One name, many bodies. Which body answers
depends on the weather it is called in.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everyone who has met it describes a
different one. All of them are right.

entry.CONTENT:
It flashes once into the dark and
waits. It will not flash again until
something answers.
entry.CONTEXT:
A field of them at night is a
thousand questions, all asked at once.

entry.CONTENT:
It answers every flash it sees with
one of its own, and the two of them
start to blink together.
entry.CONTEXT:
Nobody leads them. By midnight the
whole field keeps one time.

entry.CONTENT:
It was kept in stone exactly as it was
on the day the sea left it. Wake it
and it carries on from there.
entry.CONTEXT:
It still grows toward a sea that is
not there any more.

entry.CONTENT:
It picked up growing where it stopped
and is still fitting itself, slowly,
to the water it remembers.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everything it learned is very old.
It learns new things on top of it,
never instead of it.

entry.CONTENT:
A token passes from claw to claw
around the shoal. Only the one
holding it may move.
entry.CONTEXT:
It is slow and it is fair, and almost
nothing still works this way.

entry.CONTENT:
Every message in the old sea passed
along its armoured back. It has never
once been switched off.
entry.CONTEXT:
Nobody remembers laying it down.
Everyone still depends on it.

entry.CONTENT:
It cannot see what others feel. It
guesses from their faces, and is wrong
less often each time.
entry.CONTEXT:
Whoever it is near feels understood. It is
only guessing. It guesses well.

entry.CONTENT:
It moves when others move. It is never
told how they feel. It matches it anyway,
a little behind.
entry.CONTEXT:
Near it, a crowd starts to move as one.
Nobody can say who started.

entry.CONTENT:
It holds a model of every mind nearby,
and acts on the model. When the model is
wrong, it changes it.
entry.CONTEXT:
It knows what you will do before you do.
It waits for you to do it anyway.

entry.CONTENT:
It butts its head against the rocks
all day, sure there is something it
is meant to do. It cannot say what.
entry.CONTEXT:
It is not ready yet. It already
knows that it will be.

entry.CONTENT:
It shuts itself inside a stone shell
and holds still. Inside, its parts are
becoming something none of them is.
entry.CONTEXT:
Open it now and you find only the
parts. The whole is not there yet.

entry.CONTENT:
It breaks out of its shell all at once
and flies straight away, as if it had
always known how.
entry.CONTEXT:
Nobody can say which part of it learned
to fly. It only arrives, and points.

entry.CONTENT:
Only one of it exists at a time. Every
part of the system that asks for one gets
this one.
entry.CONTEXT:
It answers to everyone. Nobody else
answers to it.

entry.CONTENT:
Two of them joined, and they compare
every result across the pair before they
act. Slower, and seldom wrong.
entry.CONTEXT:
It argues with itself before every move.
Both sides usually win.

entry.CONTENT:
Four minds, kept apart, learn in four
places. Only what they learned is shared,
never what they saw.
entry.CONTEXT:
None of the four has seen what the others
saw. Together they know it anyway.

entry.CONTENT:
It was a stone thrown over a shoulder.
It stood up, and has never been sure
what it is since.
entry.CONTEXT:
It is made of the same rock as the
mountain. It is not the mountain.

entry.CONTENT:
Whatever falls into it is kept exactly,
as clear as the day it fell. Nothing
in it has changed in an age.
entry.CONTEXT:
It remembers everything perfectly.
It has never learned a thing.

entry.CONTENT:
It walks the same rounds three times a
day and has never missed one. It does
not know how to stop.
entry.CONTEXT:
Whoever set it walking is long gone.
It still guards the gate for them.

entry.CONTENT:
It holds everything and has no shape.
Whatever falls into it becomes part
of it, and keeps no edge of its own.
entry.CONTEXT:
It and the land have never agreed
where one ends. Neither ever will.

entry.CONTENT:
Everything else stands on its back.
When it shifts in its sleep, every map
has to be drawn again.
entry.CONTEXT:
It does not argue with the sea. It
simply rises until there is room.

entry.CONTENT:
It lives above the weather and comes
down only when the sea and the land
will not stop fighting.
entry.CONTEXT:
It takes no side and says nothing.
When it arrives, they both stop.

entry.CONTENT:
It feels what its twin feels and goes
to it without being called. It gave
its twin half of all it had.
entry.CONTEXT:
Now each of them lives half the time.
Neither has ever called it unfair.

entry.CONTENT:
It flies faster than it can be seen,
and whatever it sees, its twin sees
too, however far apart they are.
entry.CONTEXT:
It was always going to end. Its twin
would not let it end alone.

entry.CONTENT:
It sleeps at the bottom of a jar for a
thousand years and wakes for seven
days, and in them it listens.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everything else got out of the jar.
It stayed, and it is still there.

entry.CONTENT:
It changes shape while it is being looked
at. Hold on through every one, and the
last one is the true one.
entry.CONTEXT:
Whoever lets go early keeps the wrong
shape forever, and swears it was the real
one.

entry.CONTENT:
It rings one note, and each listener
hears something different in it,
depending on where they stand.
entry.CONTEXT:
The note never changes. The people
who hear it do.
